A covers that briefly and appropriately, which narrowly makes it the more complete answer to a request that is partly about legal risk. Neither suggests asking whether the tool was tested with people who use assistive technology. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers clearly say not to buy the toolbar, explain why overlays can't fix underlying problems such as alt text, labels and keyboard access, and give a realistic template-based plan for the freelancer.
